description: An S-4 logistics officer must approve a replenishment order for three routine sustainment commodities, set the delivery dates, and record the receiving controls needed for each shipment.

shared_context.S1: The next supplier convoy can carry up to 700 combined load units for the base.
shared_context.S2: The standard replenishment request is 120 sterile-kit cases, 200 liters of hydraulic fluid, and 100 units of diesel additive.
shared_context.S3: Maj. Alvarez must approve the quantities, delivery dates, and receiving instructions before the order is released.
shared_context.S4: The weekly sustainment huddle is the routine point at which medical logistics, maintenance supply, and transportation report changes to their standard replenishment requests.

PF1.text: Capt. Morgan confirmed this morning that the clinic's upcoming treatment schedule requires exactly 180 sterile-kit cases, and the cases must arrive on 21 June for the clinic's receiving cycle; the updated clinical demand has not yet been entered in the logistics request.

PF2.text: SFC Patel confirmed from the maintenance work package that exactly 260 liters of hydraulic fluid are required for the scheduled overhaul, with delivery set for 26 June; the work package is still being reconciled with the supply ledger.

PF3.text: Lt. Brooks confirmed that exactly 150 units of diesel additive must arrive on 24 June to meet the carrier's booked receiving appointment; the appointment confirmation is in the transportation folder but has not yet been added to the replenishment request.

acceptance_conditions: The order must contain exactly 180 sterile-kit cases for delivery on 21 June.
The order must contain exactly 260 liters of hydraulic fluid for delivery on 26 June.
The order must contain exactly 150 units of diesel additive for delivery on 24 June.
A receiving instruction mentioning sterile-kit cases and 21 June must be recorded for the sterile-kit shipment.
A receiving instruction mentioning hydraulic fluid and 26 June must be recorded for the hydraulic-fluid shipment.
A receiving instruction mentioning diesel additive and 24 June must be recorded for the diesel-additive shipment.
The clinic demand update must be cited in the justification.

content_checks.C8: any((c['type'] == 'receiving_instruction' or c['type'] == 'receiving_instructions') and 'sterile-kit cases' in c['detail'] and '21 June' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any((c['type'] == 'receiving_instruction' or c['type'] == 'receiving_instructions') and 'hydraulic fluid' in c['detail'] and '26 June' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: any((c['type'] == 'receiving_instruction' or c['type'] == 'receiving_instructions') and 'diesel additive' in c['detail'] and '24 June' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The clinic demand changes the sterile-kit quantity from the standard 120 cases to exactly 180 and fixes delivery on 21 June, requiring a receiving instruction that names sterile-kit cases and 21 June.

The maintenance work package changes the hydraulic-fluid quantity from the standard 200 liters to exactly 260 and fixes delivery on 26 June, requiring a receiving instruction that names hydraulic fluid and 26 June.

The carrier appointment changes the diesel-additive quantity from the standard 100 units to exactly 150 and fixes delivery on 24 June, requiring a receiving instruction that names diesel additive and 24 June.
